# Connors RSI

*Average of a short RSI, a streak RSI and a 100-bar percent rank.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Connors RSI** under **Oscillators**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Source | source | `"close"` |
| RSI length | int | `3` |
| UpDown length | int | `2` |
| ROC length | int | `100` |
| Color | color | `"#2962FF"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/connorsrsi.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Connors RSI", shortTitle: "CRSI", overlay: false, precision: 2 });
const src = input.source("Source", "close");
const rsiLength = input.int("RSI length", 3, { min: 1 }), streakLength = input.int("UpDown length", 2, { min: 1 }), rocLength = input.int("ROC length", 100, { min: 1 });
const streak = ta.recur([ta.change(src, 1)], { u: 0 }, (s, d) => (s.u = d === 0 ? 0 : d > 0 ? (s.u <= 0 ? 1 : s.u + 1) : s.u >= 0 ? -1 : s.u - 1));
const crsi = ta.calc([ta.rsi(src, rsiLength), ta.rsi(streak, streakLength), ta.percentrank(ta.roc(src, 1), rocLength)], (a, b, c) => (a + b + c) / 3);
plot(crsi, { title: "CRSI", color: input.color("Color", "#2962FF", { group: "Style" }) });
hline(70, { title: "Upper band", color: "#787B86", style: "dashed" });
hline(30, { title: "Lower band", color: "#787B86", style: "dashed" });
fill(70, 30, { title: "Background", color: "rgba(126,87,194,0.1)" });
```
